manifest.description.message: Online · US quotes and watchlist from Finnhub with your free key. Data delayed when cached; every quote shows its timestamp.
manifest.description.description: Store listing; Online and Data delayed communicate network dependency and freshness

result.help.message: Try $AAPL, stock msft, or stock aapl msft nvda. Enter opens a chart; choose Copy or use stock copy AAPL to copy a quote.

quote.as_of.description: Actual last trade timestamp, not request time; preserve {time}

quote.cached.description: Time the saved quote was fetched; preserve {time}

quote.delayed.message: Data delayed / market may be closed
quote.delayed.description: Quote is over 15 minutes old; do not imply verified exchange status

quote.sampled.message: Locally sampled Finnhub quotes, with gaps. Collects while Stocks is used; this is not historical candle data.
quote.sampled.description: Sparkline accessible label and settings explanation

error.setup.message: Open Stocks settings, get a free Finnhub key, then Test and save it.

error.auth.message: Finnhub rejected the key. Open Stocks settings to test a replacement.
error.auth.description: Authentication or plan error, no raw provider response

error.unknown.message: No quote for this symbol. Check the US ticker, including any share-class suffix.

error.unsupported.message: This provider supports US tickers only. International exchange suffixes need a different data plan.

error.invalid_symbols.message: Enter stock symbols separated by spaces or commas, such as AAPL MSFT or BRK.B.

error.too_many.message: Use at most 10 symbols per query or watchlist.

error.rate_limit.message: Request limit reached. Showing saved data when available; requests will resume after a pause.

error.offline.message: Cannot reach Finnhub. Showing saved data when available.

error.unavailable.message: Finnhub is unavailable. Showing saved data when available.

error.busy.message: Another Kage window is refreshing quotes. Try again shortly.

error.cache_only.message: Saved quotes only; live requests are paused.

error.storage.message: Quote storage is unavailable. Requests are paused until their limit can be tracked.
error.storage.description: Fail closed when rate budget cannot persist

error.invalid_key.message: Paste a Finnhub API key, then Test and save. Do not paste a URL.

settings.description.message: US stock quotes, watchlist, and local quote history. Online · Source: Finnhub. Saved values may be delayed.

settings.finnhub.message: Finnhub · US quotes · free personal key

setup.intro.message: Keyless Stooq downloads are currently unavailable. Use your own free Finnhub key for US quotes; Stocks never supplies a shared key.
setup.intro.description: Explain the authorized fallback to key setup

setup.terms.message: Finnhub's personal plans are for eligible personal use. Business use and sharing data or derived results with third parties require Finnhub approval. Check the provider's terms, including before sending quotes to a remote agent.

setup.steps.message: 1. Open Get a free key and register at Finnhub. 2. Copy your API key from its dashboard. 3. Paste it below and choose Test and save. 4. Save your watchlist and provider settings.

setup.saved.message: A key is saved on this device. Leave the field empty to test it, or paste a replacement. Stored keys are never shown here.
setup.saved.description: Connected setup state without secret disclosure

setup.free_key.description: Open provider registration in system browser

setup.key_hint.message: Test and save stores the key in private extension data, like Spotify credentials. Typing it here does not save it with regular settings. This host's text field is visible while you type.

setup.test.description: Probe quote endpoint and save only on success

setup.remove.description: Delete provider credentials; retain cached quotes

setup.removed.message: Key removed. Saved quotes remain available.

setup.success.message: Finnhub quote test passed; key saved. Save the provider and watchlist settings to finish.

settings.watchlist_hint.message: Up to {max} US symbols, separated by spaces or commas. An empty list hides the widget.

settings.show.message: Show watchlist in the floating window

settings.refresh.description: Quote cache and widget refresh interval

settings.refresh_hint.message: Minimum 60 seconds; default 300. Hidden-window polls pause on current Kage hosts. At most 40 requests per minute are reserved across this device; provider limits also include your other apps.

settings.refresh_error.message: Refresh interval must be between 60 and 3600 seconds.

tool.quote.message: Get US stock quotes from Finnhub for personal use. Returns source, last-trade timestamp, cache freshness and per-symbol errors. Requires the user's free key; do not redistribute without provider approval.

tool.symbols.message: Up to 10 US symbols, for example ["AAPL", "MSFT", "BRK.B"].

tool.history.message: Get locally sampled Finnhub quotes observed on this device for 1d, 1w or 1m. No network requests. Incomplete, sparse samples, not historical candles; an empty list means nothing was collected.
tool.history.description: Agent tool scope must not imply full historical coverage
